id: \rI can teach your Pokémon a move.
en: \rI can teach your Pokémon a move.
it: \rPosso insegnare una mossa ai tuoi Pokémon.

id: \bWait a minute! You haven't even beat Brock yet.
en: \bWait a minute! You haven't even beat Brock yet.
it: \bAspetta un attimo! Non hai ancora nemmeno battuto Brock.

id: \rBesides being a Gym Leader, Brock also takes care of his nine younger siblings.
en: \rBesides being a Gym Leader, Brock also takes care of his nine younger siblings.
it: \rOltre a essere un Capopalestra, Brock si occupa anche dei suoi nove fratelli più piccoli.

id: \rThis path leads to the Battle Pyramid. Only Trainers who have beat the six other Frontiers may go here.
en: \rThis path leads to the Battle Pyramid. Only Trainers who have beat the six other Frontiers may go here.
it: \rQuesto sentiero porta alla Piramide Lotta. Possono accedervi solo gli Allenatori che hanno superato le altre sei strutture del Parco Lotta.

id: Rotom Phone: Based on performance, your rank is now 978. You have entered the Great Class.
en: Rotom Phone: Based on performance, your rank is now 978. You have entered the Great Class.
it: Smart Rotom: In base ai risultati, ora sei al posto 978 della classifica. Sei entrato nella Classe Super.

id: Announcement. New opponent found for the World Coronation Series. Bea, located in Cianwood City, is ready for battle.
en: Announcement. New opponent found for the World Coronation Series. Bea, located in Cianwood City, is ready for battle.
it: Annuncio. Trovato un nuovo avversario per il World Coronation Series. Fabia, a Fiorlisopoli, è pronta per la lotta.

id: \bPity. I'm happy someone advanced to the next rank though.
en: \bPity. I'm happy someone advanced to the next rank though.
it: \bPeccato. Però sono contento che qualcuno sia salito di grado.
Capopalestra della Palestra Pokémon di Plumbeopoli: \nBrock

id: \bBrock uses Rock type Pokémon. It's good to have a Fighting Pokémon against him.
en: \bBrock uses Rock type Pokémon. It's good to have a Fighting Pokémon against him.
it: \bBrock usa Pokémon di tipo Roccia. Contro di lui conviene avere un Pokémon di tipo Lotta.

id: \bI'm spraying Repel to keep wild Pokémon out of my garden!
en: \bI'm spraying Repel to keep wild Pokémon out of my garden!
it: \bSpruzzo Repellente per tenere i Pokémon selvatici fuori dal mio giardino!

id: \rDown this path is the Battle Pyramid.
en: \rDown this path is the Battle Pyramid.
it: \rIn fondo a questo sentiero c'è la Piramide Lotta.

id: \bThere aren't many serious Pokémon Trainers here.
en: \bThere aren't many serious Pokémon Trainers here.
it: \bQui non ci sono molti Allenatori di Pokémon seri.
